views.name: clinical_patient_basic_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "bcr_patient_uuid" AS bcr_patient_uuid,
  "bcr_patient_barcode" AS bcr_patient_barcode,
  "patient_id" AS patient_id,
  "project_code" AS project_code,
  "gender" AS gender,
  "race" AS race,
  "ethnicity" AS ethnicity,
  "vital_status" AS vital_status,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER("age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis") AS age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER("year_of_initial_pathologic_diagnosis") AS year_of_initial_pathologic_diagnosis,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER(NULLIF("days_to_death", '')) AS days_to_death,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER(NULLIF("days_to_last_followup", '')) AS days_to_last_followup,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER(NULLIF("days_to_initial_pathologic_diagnosis", '')) AS days_to_initial_pathologic_diagnosis,
  "icd_10" AS icd_10,
  "icd_o_3_site" AS icd_o_3_site,
  "icd_o_3_histology" AS icd_o_3_histology,
  "histological_type" AS histological_type,
  "pathologic_stage" AS pathologic_stage,
  "clinical_stage" AS clinical_stage,
  "primary_therapy_outcome_success" AS primary_therapy_outcome_success,
  "person_neoplasm_cancer_status" AS person_neoplasm_cancer_status,
  "diagnosis" AS diagnosis,
  "hiv_status" AS hiv_status,
  "hpv_test" AS hpv_test
FROM PANCANCER_ATLAS_1.PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED.CLINICAL_PANCAN_PATIENT_WITH_FOLLOWUP_FILTERED
grain: bcr_patient_barcode (one row per patient record in source table)
views.description: Normalized patient-level clinical demographics and key identifiers. Cleans and projects canonical join keys and common demographic/time-to-event columns for downstream joins and cohort filters. Use this when you need a stable patient-level relation with typed numeric measures for survival/time fields and canonical identifiers. | Use for: Cohort selection by demographics (gender/race/project_code); Survival/time-to-event calculations and summaries; Joining clinical attributes to molecular assays by patient barcode; Filtering patients by stage/diagnosis for downstream molecular comparisons

views.name: clinical_patient_active_followup_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "bcr_patient_uuid" AS bcr_patient_uuid,
  "bcr_patient_barcode" AS bcr_patient_barcode,
  "patient_id" AS patient_id,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF("days_to_last_followup", '') IS NOT NULL
      OR NULLIF("days_to_death", '') IS NOT NULL
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS has_followup,
  "vital_status" AS vital_status,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER(NULLIF("days_to_last_followup", '')) AS days_to_last_followup,
  TRY_TO_NUMBER(NULLIF("days_to_death", '')) AS days_to_death
FROM PANCANCER_ATLAS_1.PANCANCER_ATLAS_FILTERED.CLINICAL_PANCAN_PATIENT_WITH_FOLLOWUP_FILTERED
grain: bcr_patient_barcode (one row per patient record in source table)
views.description: Subset of clinical patients flagged with active follow-up or alive status. Exposes a boolean-like flag (has_followup) and preserved identifiers. Use to quickly restrict joins/aggregations to patients with at least one follow-up or known last-followup/death time. | Use for: Selecting patients with any follow-up information; Comparing outcomes for patients with and without follow-up; Joining to molecular assays but restricting to patients with follow-up
